commands.name: notes
commands.description: Open or close the notepad pane; /notes find <text> searches, /notes tags lists tags, /notes export and /notes import sync NOTES.md, /notes undo restores the last archived notes

commands.name: note
commands.description: Add a note for this project (-g for a global note, -b for the current git branch only, #words become tags; --last saves Claude's last reply)
commands.output: Multi-line editor opened. Or add a quick note with /note <text> (-g for global).

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Add a note to the user's notepad (a sidebar they keep across sessions). Use it for follow-ups, TODOs or things to remember later that are not worth doing now. Notes belong to the current project unless `global` is true (use global only for things unrelated to this project). Keep each note short and self-contained. Tag notes with #hashtags in the text (for example #bug, #idea, #todo); prefer tags the user already uses, which list_notes reports.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List the notes in the user's notepad: this project's notes and the global ones, with whether each is done or pinned, and each note's id (for complete_note and update_note). Notes of another git branch of this project are left out until it is checked out; a note marked (branch name) belongs to that branch. A note with a #due:YYYY-MM-DD date is marked (overdue) or (due today) while open, and a list with dated notes ends with today's date. With `query`, search every note (all projects) for notes containing all of its words; a #word in the query matches that tag exactly. Also lists the tags in use.

tools.name: complete_note
tools.description: Mark a note in the user's notepad done, for example a TODO you have just finished, or (with `done: false`) open again. Take the id from list_notes or add_note. Only mark a note done when the work it describes is actually finished.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace the text of a note in the user's notepad, for example to record progress or correct it. Take the id from list_notes or add_note. Keep the note's #tags unless they no longer apply.

children: Click the box to type · Enter new line · Ctrl+S save · arrows, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn move · Esc leaves the box
